target_customer: Consumers who want long-form magazine journalism as narrated audio, paying by subscription
problem: People lack time to read long-form articles. Audm turned them into professionally narrated audio.

founders.name: Christian Brink
founders.background_notes: No background on the YC page.

founders.name: Ryan Wegner
founders.background_notes: No background on the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: A mobile app plus a contractor narration pipeline; the hard part was editorial and publisher licensing, not engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Publisher relationships and narrator quality were the asset; the idea was easy to copy by publishers themselves.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The New York Times bought Audm in March 2020 and launched NYT Audio in 2023, dropping several third-party publishers per a reviewer in search results.

market_need_then: Audio and podcast listening was rising in 2017 and Audm partnered with publications such as Wired, The Atlantic, ProPublica and others; a source cites over 34,000 subscribers.

branding.domain_note: Used audm.com; it now redirects to the NYT Audio promotion per a search result.

identity.voice_and_tone: Tagline: listen to the best journalism.

rebrands.why: The New York Times folded the product into its own audio app; Audm was withdrawn.

brand_strength.rationale: Coverage in TechCrunch and others, a loyal but small subscriber base, no merch or community evidence.

outcome_analysis: Audm built a niche subscription app for narrated long-form journalism with prominent publisher partners and a small paying base, and was acquired by the New York Times in March 2020 with terms undisclosed. The Times then replaced it with NYT Audio in 2023. Funding is only known from aggregators so the scale of the outcome relative to capital is unknown.
notes: Seedtable (aggregator) lists a roughly 120K seed in August 2017 with Y Combinator and Switch Ventures; Bounce Watch lists about 1.5M in July 2018 from Precursor Ventures and Switch Ventures. Both single aggregators, unverified, no rounds recorded. Company site returned 503. The strong_pmf tag rests on one subscriber count and is weak. No dated competitor source near 2017 was found, list empty.
